skills.name: pre-trade-check
skills.description: Pre-trade go/no-go gate: route a trade idea through news sentiment, technical verdict, and MT5 risk guards before propose_trade.

skills.name: portfolio-risk-review
skills.description: Whole-book risk review: concentration, correlation, catalyst clustering, and live MT5 fragility before adding or keeping exposure.

skills.name: position-management
skills.description: Decide hold / trim / tighten / exit on an open MT5 position by checking live price against thesis, invalidation, and catalyst risk.

skills.name: post-trade-debrief
skills.description: Post-trade review: reconstruct the plan, check execution and rule adherence, and extract a portable lesson.

skills.name: execution-plan-check
skills.description: Pre-flight a plan for executability: symbol resolution, safety guards, proposal expiry, and position capacity before propose_trade.

skills.name: position-sizing
skills.description: Compute a conservative risk_percent for execute_trade from equity, risk budget, entry, stop, and the max-risk guard.

skills.name: risk-reward-sanity-check
skills.description: Test entry/stop/target coherence and asymmetry (R-multiple, stop placement, target realism) before propose_trade.

skills.name: thesis-validation
skills.description: Pressure-test a trade thesis: core claim, evidence vs assumption, invalidation, timeframe, and dependencies before sizing.

skills.name: evidence-gap-check
skills.description: Rank missing facts, assumptions, and open questions by decision impact before an idea is sized or acted on.

skills.name: watchlist-review
skills.description: Triage a watchlist: rank names into active / background / drop using sentiment, technicals, catalysts, and redundancy.
